The Gratata is a largely sprawling, ground growing vine, similar to the [Wandering Jew plant](https://images.duckduckgo.com/iu/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fpics.davesgarden.com%2Fpics%2F2007%2F04%2F30%2Fonalee%2Ff20e44.jpg&f=1), except it is translucent, not green. It sprouts little blue flowers at the end of each leaf, but they are closed, unless exposed to extremely high levels of sound for elongated periods of time, which causes gas to build up in the flower buds at an extremely high pressure, until the bud opens up and propels the pollen into the air.

The released gas, when inhaled by air breathing beings, has a side effect. It heightens your senses to extreme levels, increases your energy levels, distorts your sense of time (slows it down) and creates a euphoric sense state of being. These effects last for up to 7 hours. The flower buds can be removed from the plant just before it opens up, in order to store the gas for later. However, the buds must be used within 48 hours or they will die and the gas will dissipate.

Prolonged use of the resulting gas can lead to hair loss, and in extreme cases, when exposed to the gas for multiple days at a time, can cause skin/scales of creatures that breathe it to turn extremely pale.
